Catalog.Product.description: A product that customers can order.

columns.ModifiedAt: Moment the row was last changed; empty when it never changed.
columns.ModifiedBy: Identity of the user or process that last changed the row.
columns.Name: Name of the product as shown in the shop.
columns.Sku: Stock keeping unit: the code that identifies the product in the warehouse.
columns.UnitPrice: Current price of one unit, excluding tax.

columns.Code: Stable code of the category, used by the application.
columns.Name: Display name of the category.

columns.BaseUrl: Base address of the provider's API in this environment.
columns.IsEnabled: Whether the shop offers this provider to customers.
columns.Name: Display name of the provider.
columns.PaymentProviderId: Unique identifier of the payment provider.

Sales.Customer.description: A person or organisation that places orders.

columns.DisplayName: Name of the customer as shown in the shop.

columns.ModifiedAt: Moment the row was last changed; empty when it never changed.

Sales.Order.description: An order placed by a customer.

columns.CurrencyCode: ISO 4217 code of the currency of all amounts in the order.
columns.ModifiedAt: Moment the row was last changed; empty when it never changed.

columns.Note: Free text the customer added to the order.
columns.OrderedAt: Moment the customer placed the order.

columns.Quantity: Number of units ordered; always more than zero.
